note: S16 site security (M8). Every number here is in TICKS at 10Hz. The alarm is STAGED on purpose (D44): an instant-fail alarm makes the correct play 'reload', and there is no reload in a persistent shared world — so a mistake has to become a worsening situation the player is still inside.
note_alarm: Stages: 0 clear, 1 local, 2 lockdown, 3 district. Deliberately slow: stage 1 -> 2 is 30s of continuing to be burned near the site, and stage 2 -> 3 another minute. The player must have time to read what is happening and choose, or the escalation is a tax rather than a puzzle (D45).
note_radius: MUST stay below citygen.sites.minSpacing (5). At radius 6 a single burn woke every neighbouring facility at once, because sites are placed as close as 5 cells apart — so the player could not tell which building had reacted to them, and the alarm read as weather rather than as consequence. test/security.test.js asserts the relationship so a future citygen spacing change cannot silently reintroduce it.
